title: Dream Kitchen Chef
description: Fire up the grill in a lively gourmet restaurant—plate sizzling dishes, chain fast combo tips, upgrade kitchen appliances, and unlock global culinary themes.
controls: Tap raw ingredients to cook, plate finished meals, and serve hungry guests before their patience bars run low.

zh-CN.title: 梦幻厨房
zh-CN.description: 经典时间管理爆款梦幻厨房：煎烤烹炸手速飞起，精准上菜赚取连击小费，升级厨具解锁世界各地人气美食餐厅！
zh-CN.controls: 点击食材下锅烹饪并装盘递给对应顾客，升级厨具加快出餐赚取连击金币。
